summary: Frozen two-candidate capability ladder (M-14B-QWEN primary, M-8B-LLAMA secondary) under the audited single-factor minimal Web-agent protocol, plus an independent 12-provider hosted-endpoint census and a 3-entry external-comparator readiness table. Step-1 PREFLIGHT PASSED all five frozen checks (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (parseable 0.0, success 0.0); B-RANDOM-ACTION (parseable 1.0, success 0.2 < 0.6); all freeze_artifact hashes match; required stack imports OK) through the real frozen scorer and a served page. The ladder then failed at frozen step 3a for BOTH candidates: the downloaded GGUF bytes match the frozen byte counts but their sha256 differs from the frozen-pinned sha256. Investigation shows the frozen pin equals the HF tree API xetHash and the CDN etag, while the served bytes' sha256 equals the tree API lfs.oid; three independent download routes (resolve, ?download=true, hf.co) all reproduce the same body hash, so the served content is stable and authentic and the frozen pin is self-consistently mismatched with body bytes (the spec note 'sha256 equals the HF LFS OID (CDN etag)' conflated xetHash/etag with lfs.oid). Per frozen rule 3a every mismatched candidate is recorded UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED and no model was loaded (fail-closed; a digest mismatch is never converted into a capability failure). With no COMPLETE cell, frozen rule 4 yields OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED (canonical mapping: status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE). The endpoint census (non-gating) found 0 PROVISIONABLE_CREDENTIATED, 10 CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED, 1 CREDENTIAL_FREE_OPERATIONALLY_CAPPED (Pollinations) and 1 UNREACHABLE (HuggingFace Inference) provider; the external comparators table pinned 3/3 primary sources labelled CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE. No claim is promoted, weakened or falsified: the capability question remains unmeasured for operational/substrate reasons, not scientific ones.

The raw/controls.json produced here is byte-identical to the audited parent's (sha256 b0120e61be812a91b680cf848d01dc756cfd0dfc9a329ec8b78ba65c663ff639), i.e. the oracle/null/random controls deterministically replicated across experiments.

M-14B-QWEN: frozen-pinned sha256 d989c91de35f32c18bdb8bec96a4b9fff2c3e5bca066503c63a5ca54dd537a4b and bytes 8988110976. Downloaded bytes are 8988110976 but sha256=e47ad95dad6ff848b431053b375adb5d39321290ea2c638682577dafca87c008 -> frozen step 3a mismatch -> UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (no load attempted).

M-8B-LLAMA: frozen-pinned sha256 854506123b68372492b8a99bb3a999594672b394791cf1153f8da5ffb5f1c59a and bytes 4920739232. Downloaded bytes are 4920739232 but sha256=7b064f5842bf9532c91456deda288a1b672397a54fa729aa665952863033557c -> frozen step 3a mismatch -> UNMEASURED_LOAD_FAILED (no load attempted).

Root cause of the mismatch: the frozen pin equals the HF tree-API xetHash and the CDN etag, whereas the served bytes' sha256 equals the tree-API lfs.oid. HF tree API: lfs.oid=e47ad95d.../7b064f58..., xetHash=d989c91d.../85450612.... CDN HEAD redirect path and etag header both carry the pinned xetHash; the response body hashes to the lfs.oid. The specification note 'sha256 equals the HF LFS OID (CDN etag)' conflated the xetHash/CDN-etag with the lfs.oid.

The served bytes are stable and authentic: three independent download routes (huggingface.co resolve, resolve?download=true, hf.co) reproduced identical body sha256 and identical byte counts. This is not transport corruption or a corrupted local copy; the frozen byte-level identity is unsatisfiable against the currently served content.

Failure-classification discipline: a frozen digest mismatch is an operational/substrate condition, not a capability result. No candidate was loaded, so no model behaviour was observed; the mismatch was never converted into a capability failure.

Reported numbers are recorded with denominators and reproduction prerequisites; none is treated as this experiment's evidence.

Frozen rule 4 application: after the ladder no candidate is COMPLETE, so OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and B3_STATUS=UNRESOLVED (canonical mapping status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE). The census and comparator records are written but do not override the frozen outcome.

Both materialized per-candidate overlays are confined to prompts.system, candidate_models_frozen and (for M-8B-LLAMA) sampling.chat_format relative to the frozen base config; config/overlay sha256s are recorded. No measurement code or task fixture was modified.
validity_notes: MEASUREMENT_INVALID transaction: the experiment's capability question was not answered. This is a substrate/provisioning failure (unobtainable frozen GGUF byte identity), not a scientific negative; it must not be encoded as FALSIFIES or as evidence about model capability.
No claim state changes: C-LLM-INHERIT remains at its inherited Codex effective event (parent EXP-INTEL-38164607941 FALSIFIES). This transaction neither promotes nor weakens it.

Primary blocker: at EXECUTE both frozen GGUF pins (byte count matches, sha256 mismatch) differ from the served bytes, whose sha256 equals the current HF lfs.oid while the pin equals xetHash/CDN-etag. No model was loaded (fail-closed, frozen rule 3a). Mismatched bytes were never substituted for the frozen candidates.

Smallest unblocking action: either (a) re-pin each candidate to the byte-level sha256 actually served (verified by full download) after an independent byte check, and re-freeze; or (b) vendor the exact GGUF bytes in an immutable artifact store keyed by byte sha256; or (c) at DESIGN time, compute the sha256 from downloaded bytes rather than from HF server metadata (etag/xetHash). Any re-freeze must keep the same candidate identities (model, quant, chat_format, URL) and only correct the digest/bytes binding.

Freeze-process validity threat (generic): the v2 freeze_eligibility check for candidate digest verification appears to have been satisfied via server metadata (etag/xetHash) rather than byte download. This experiment is an existence proof that metadata-vs-body mismatch can silently pass freeze; downstream experiments pinning HF GGUFs should byte-verify at freeze.

Positive-control coverage: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION and B-RANDOM-ACTION were executed through the real frozen scorer; the per-candidate 10-probe PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING gate did not run because no candidate loaded (recorded NOT_APPLICABLE, with carried parent 10/10 as context only).

Census is a snapshot: classifications reflect env-var presence and unauthenticated reachability at EXECUTE time; no API keys were present and no provider model was invoked, so hosted capability remains untested by design.
The comparator table is a readiness/enumeration artifact (CANDIDATE_NOT_EVIDENCE); reported comparison numbers have not been reproduced under this protocol and are not used in the decision.

Determinism/leakage: per-candidate overlays differ from the frozen base only in the predeclared single factor (prompt treatment) plus frozen candidate bindings and chat_format; the reported leakage booleans are preserved in raw/materialized_configs.json.
unresolved: Whether the frozen pinned digests were incorrect at DESIGN time (metadata-only read of xetHash/etag) or became stale because the served body changed between design (2026-10-11) and execute (2026-10-12). Available evidence (pin==xetHash==etag; body==lfs.oid; multiple stable routes) is consistent with a metadata-only design read, but the historical state was not captured at design time and is not directly reconstructable.

Whether the origin GGUF bytes that hash to the frozen pins remain retrievable anywhere (the HF commits API listing did not surface these GGUF files and no old-OID blob could be fetched during EXECUTE).

The capability of the M-14B-QWEN and M-8B-LLAMA classes under the frozen minimal Web-agent protocol: entirely unmeasured, so the inherited 3B-8B local ceiling for C-LLM-INHERIT is neither extended nor re-confirmed.
Whether the HF Xet-bridge metadata/body mismatch (etag/xetHash path vs lfs.oid body) affects other pinned GGUFs used by other lanes; not surveyed here.

No capability evidence for any hosted provider was gathered (census is reachability/credential only); the smallest next action for the hosted branch is unchanged from the frozen spec (a credentialed endpoint test), which this transaction could not provision.
